10 Usage Guidelines
Web & Digital
Online Presence
  • White transparent on dark navbars
  • Black transparent on light/white pages
  • Gold transparent on navy hero sections
  • White for all app icons (dark BG)
  • Black favicon on browser tabs
  • Gold for premium landing pages
Print & Packaging
Physical Media
  • Black transparent on kraft export boxes
  • Black transparent on all letterhead
  • White transparent on dark business cards
  • Gold on navy premium stationery
  • Black on invoices, docs & certificates
  • Mid-gray for fax / photocopy use
Social & Marketing
Brand Campaigns
  • White on navy for LinkedIn posts
  • Gold on dark for premium campaigns
  • Black transparent on Instagram reels
  • White on black for WhatsApp business
  • Green cleared stamp for trade updates
  • Red alert for urgent trade advisories
Clear Space & Minimum Size Rules
X
X
Clear space = X on all sides
Minimum print size: 20mm width
Minimum digital size: 32px width
Never stretch, skew or rotate the logo
Never place on busy/low-contrast backgrounds
Always use the transparent PNG — never add white fill manually
